findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "annsurv_account" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Your servers, plan and trial status (Bearer token required).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: annsurv_check · Private data: annsurv_account · Public sink: annsurv_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: annsurv_check · Private data: annsurv_account · Public sink: annsurv_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
